headline: Revenue accelerates and margins hold as outlook rises
summary_short: Revenue rose to $438.3M, up 32.1% y/y, on 9.7% same-restaurant sales growth and 20 net new openings, while diluted EPS fell to $0.20 from $0.22 a year ago on a higher effective tax rate.
summary_long: CAVA revenue grew 32.2% y/y to $434.4M as 92 net new restaurant openings over the trailing year and 9.7% same-restaurant sales (6.8% traffic, 2.9% price/mix) offset the lap of strong prior-year comps. Restaurant-level profit margin held flat at 25.1% as higher third-party delivery mix and wage investment were offset by sales leverage. Net income fell to $23.6M (-8.3% y/y) purely on a lower tax benefit from equity compensation and higher depreciation, not operating weakness — Adjusted EBITDA rose 37.6% to $61.7M. Cash and equivalents were $295.8M, up from $282.9M at fiscal year-end. Free cash flow was $15.5M. The company raised fiscal 2026 guidance across same-restaurant sales, new openings, and Adjusted EBITDA.

drivers.explanation: Driven by 92 net new CAVA restaurant openings during or subsequent to Q1 FY2025 and same-restaurant sales growth of 9.7%, itself 6.8% from guest traffic and 2.9% from menu price/mix.
Decrease driven by a lower tax benefit from equity-based compensation (raising the effective tax rate) and higher depreciation and amortization, partially offset by improved operating performance.
Growth attributed to the increase in same-restaurant sales, continued strong performance of recent net new restaurant openings, and leverage in general and administrative expenses.
Restaurant-level profit margin was flat y/y at 25.1% as higher third-party delivery mix and wage investment were offset by leverage from higher sales.
